entities.summary: Ryan O'Marra is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. O'Marra played professionally from 2006 until 2018. A first-round pick of the New York Islanders of the National Hockey League (NHL), O'Marra played 33 games in the NHL and finished his career playing in European leagues. He is the only person born in Japan to have scored a goal in the NHL.
